overview: The main theme is AI compute economics. Elon Musk says debt markets have largely shut off financing for AI cloud companies without outside revenue, and Chamath and Sarah Guo add their own views on stranded compute and inference supply. Grok Bot added phone calling, and SpaceX ran a full static fire ahead of Starship Flight 15. Much of the feed was politics (US races, Ukraine, Toronto, Israel), which is skipped here.

top_items.title: elonmusk - Debt markets have nearly shut off for AI clouds without non-AI revenue; SpaceX closed $40B GPU debt, 200+ neoclouds face consolidation
Chamath Palihapitiya - Predicts lots of partly stranded or idle compute in 2027 from pipeline delays, hitting everyone but one player
elonmusk - Grok Bot can now phone people or businesses for you, wait on hold, and send a summary; v0.77 also adds Tailscale and payments screens
Greg Brockman - Quotes a mathematician calling OpenAI's math paper 'maybe beyond what a human could have come up with'
elonmusk - Super Heavy completed a full-duration 33-engine static fire ahead of Starship Flight 15
Matthew Berman - Says image, video and voice generation now run well locally; a LTX 2.5 video took minutes on his DGX Station
Sarah Guo - Argues AI startups need inference vendors with freely allocatable capacity, since closed labs ration GPUs; owning power and chips repeats colo's mistake
elonmusk - Aer Lingus now offers free Starlink Wi-Fi on all U.S. routes; a shared post says Starlink passed AT&T Fiber in subscribers
